RoselineMCP
Table of Contents

Docker Deployment

Deploy RoselineMCP using Docker containers.

Quick Start

Pull and Run

# Pull latest image
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

# Run container
docker run --rm -it phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

Multi-Architecture Support

Platform-Specific Images

# AMD64/x64
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest --platform linux/amd64

# ARM64 (Apple Silicon, AWS Graviton)
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest --platform linux/arm64

Building Images

Using .NET SDK Container Support

# Build for x64
dotnet publish RoselineMCP/RoselineMCP.csproj \
  --os linux --arch x64 \
  /t:PublishContainer -c Release

# Build for ARM64
dotnet publish RoselineMCP/RoselineMCP.csproj \
  --os linux --arch arm64 \
  /t:PublishContainer -c Release

Using the Publish Script

# Publish with version tag
./publish-docker.sh --version 1.0.0 --latest

# Build only (no push)
./publish-docker.sh --version 1.0.0 --no-push

Docker Compose

version: '3.8'

services:
  roseline-mcp:
    image: phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest
    container_name: roseline-mcp
    environment:
      - ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL=Information
      - ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production
    volumes:
      - ./solutions:/workspace:ro
    restart: unless-stopped

Kubernetes Deployment

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: roseline-mcp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: roseline-mcp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: roseline-mcp
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: roseline-mcp
        image: phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest
        env:
        - name: ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL
          value: "Information"
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: "2Gi"
            cpu: "1000m"
          requests:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "250m"

Volume Mounting

Analyzing Local Solutions

docker run --rm -it \
  -v /path/to/solution:/workspace:ro \
  phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest \
  analyzeSolution --path /workspace/Solution.sln

With Configuration

docker run --rm -it \
  -v ./appsettings.json:/app/appsettings.json:ro \
  -e ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production \
  phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

Environment Variables

Variable Description Default
ROSELINE_LOG_LEVEL Logging level Information
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT Environment Production
DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT Globalization false

Health Checks

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s \
  CMD dotnet RoselineMCP.dll --health || exit 1

Resource Requirements

Minimum

  • CPU: 0.25 cores
  • Memory: 512MB
  • Storage: 100MB

Recommended

  • CPU: 1 core
  • Memory: 2GB
  • Storage: 500MB

Security Best Practices

  1. Run as non-root user
  2. Use read-only volumes
  3. Limit resource consumption
  4. Scan images for vulnerabilities
  5. Use specific version tags

Troubleshooting

Container Exits Immediately

# Check logs
docker logs roseline-mcp

# Run with shell
docker run --rm -it --entrypoint /bin/sh phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

Permission Denied

# Fix volume permissions
docker run --rm -it \
  --user $(id -u):$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/solution:/workspace:ro \
  phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest
